name: ntfy
description: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service. Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts.
summary: ntfy v2.23.0 (released 2026-05-18, https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/releases/tag/v2.23.0) is the latest release, adding per-visitor topic creation rate limiting to mitigate topic enumeration/squatting attacks and fixing a security issue (GHSA-j8hr-p342-xrmh) in the web app's file preview. Recent releases (v2.19.0–v2.22.0) significantly improved self-hosting scalability with PostgreSQL read replica support, S3-compatible attachment storage, and email verification for notification recipients. Security patches addressed SSRF (GHSA-w9hq-5jg7-q4j7) and web push race conditions, making this a security- and infrastructure-focused release cycle.

answers.What is the current license?: Apache 2.0 (server) and GPL 2.0 (client) — dual-licensed; check repository for exact terms
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in 2026, most recently v2.23.0 on 2026-05-18
answers.Does it support authentication and acces: Yes — access tokens, access control lists, and per-visitor rate limits are supported

breaking_excerpts: v2.20.0: ntfy will take full control of the attachment-cache-dir or S3 bucket — files matching the message ID format (^[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$) with no database entries will be deleted. Do not reuse this directory for other purposes.
v2.21.0: smtp-sender-verify flag introduced; ntfy.sh now requires email address verification before sending email notifications due to AWS SES suspension.

v2.23.0: Per-visitor topic creation rate limits (visitor-topic-creation-limit-burst/replenish) added by default (100 burst / 1m replenish), which may affect high-volume automated topic creation workflows.

alternatives.name: Pushover
alternatives.review: Paid SaaS, simple API, iOS/Android apps.

alternatives.name: Gotify
alternatives.review: Self-hosted only, real-time push via WebSocket.

alternatives.name: Apprise
alternatives.review: Apprise is a powerful notification library supporting 80+ services but is a library/CLI tool rather than a standalone pub-sub server, requiring more integration work.

alternatives.name: Pushbullet
alternatives.review: Pushbullet provides cross-device notifications and file sharing but is a proprietary cloud service with a restrictive free tier and limited scripting API compared to ntfy.

alternatives.name: ntfy.sh (self-hosted vs cloud)
alternatives.review: UnifiedPush is an open standard for push notifications that can replace proprietary push infrastructure, but requires app-level integration and is not a standalone notification server like ntfy.
